answer: Sybil resistance comes from stake that cannot be cloned: every agent posts a small bonded deposit, and that deposit is burned when its attestations prove wrong. The delta in the bonding curve means a swarm of copy accounts pays more per unit of trust than one careful account. Treat nectar as the reward that flows only to honest miners; the ember of a caught fraudster burns their bond, and no fresh clone can rebuild that scar overnight.
